Product Details
This course is designed to help professionals and organizational leaders understand and adapt to the growing influence of artificial intelligence. Explore how AI is transforming roles by automating manual tasks and shifting responsibilities toward interpreting AI-generated insights and maintaining ethical oversight. The course content emphasizes the importance of human accountability in ensuring accuracy and fairness and promoting AI literacy across technical and nontechnical teams. In addition, it addresses the safe and compliant use of AI tools by employees and considerations for implementation of privacy impact assessments, ethical reviews and ongoing audits.
Learning Experience:
Text and video-based content

Who Will Benefit
This course is designed for cybersecurity professionals seeking to ensure necessary skills related to AI and staffing of cybersecurity teams in their organizations. Recommended prerequisite knowledge includes an understanding of cybersecurity concepts and principles, as well as knowledge of cybersecurity roles and organizational security practices and decision-making.
Key Topics
Artificial intelligence and machine learning
Program management
Organizational alignment
Learning Outcomes
Explain the impact of AI on cybersecurity jobs
Describe the strategies for workforce adaptation and training
Assess security considerations for employees using AI (LLMs) for work productivity
Ensure compliance with privacy regulations in AI implementations
Benefits
Learn leadership strategies for adapting to the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the cybersecurity workforce
Participate in activities centered on real-world applications
Earn CPE credits
Program Completion
Learners have 60 days from the date of purchase to complete the entire course. Those who successfully complete this course will receive a digital Validation of Completion and earn continuing professional education (CPE) credits. We recommend that you download and retain the Validation of Completion for your personal records.
To receive a Validation of Completion and earn CPE credits, learners must:
Complete the learning experience
Pass the assessment
Complete the learning experience evaluation

CPE Credit Reporting
CPE credits earned from this learning experience will automatically be reported for ISC2 credentials on the first day of every month. Please allow up to 10 business days for processing.
CPE credits earned for this learning experience may also be eligible for continuing professional education credits for non-ISC2 certifications. Please visit the continuing education requirements established by the credentialing organization for eligibility.
For questions related to ISC2 CPE credits or the CPE portal not covered in the handbook, please contact us via our online form.
